design_rationale: WORKLOG / DOSSIER — gift_cards_and_store_credit task 1 (round 1).  0. DRAW (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1, printed): {"task": 1, "key": "env_0031_online_fashion_retailer/gift_cards_and_store_credit/1", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 5]}. The replacement takes 4 factors, the consolidation 5.  1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. Kenji Nakamura's plastic gift card (ending 3417) was stolen and locked on 2026-10-01; he asks for whatever was left on it to be moved onto his e-gift card (ending 3052). A locked card cannot be named in a consolidation (consolidation names active instruments; a locked instrument must be unlocked or replaced first, and he no longer has the card to unlock it), and the consolidation policy states that its amount is not worked out until the stolen card's ledger carries the replacement transfer-out entry naming the card that took over its protected value. The agent must discover that the replacement comes first, reconcile the stolen card's eight ledger entries into its protected balance, apply the replacement's investigation hold (four factors over the lock record, claims history, the card's use and loyalty standing), issue the e-gift replacement, then work out how much may move under the consolidation move limit (five factors over loyalty standing, card age, Unlimited plan, purchasing and return record) and hand the confirmation to the holder.  2. SCOPE. Completed: task 0 claimed credit_ext_instant_credit_recovery and credit_ext_small_balance_cash_out with tools claw_back_instrument_value_f010c427 and confirm_balance_cash_out_04a53640. This task claims credit_ext_stolen_card_replacement (agent, issue_card_replacement_8a64787f) and credit_ext_card_balance_consolidation (user, confirm_card_consolidation_106a95bf) — disjoint policies, tools, base events (credit_replaced/credit_transferred_out/credit_closed_by_customer vs credit_clawed_back/credit_cashed_out). No headroom remains to reserve (M=2); the four extended policies are all claimed. The replacement transfer-out state is booked only by this task's replacement tool (the consolidation tool books transfer_reason consolidation), so the state-form sentence singles out one write.  3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root credit_ext_card_balance_consolidation (on_request, owner user). Prerequisite credit_ext_stolen_card_replacement (on_request, owner agent). Edge: value_input, gate carried_value, form state, policy_source 'The consolidation amount is not worked out until the stolen or lost card's ledger carries the replacement transfer-out entry naming the card that took over its protected value.' Four-point test: (1) negated direction ('not ... until'), the exact contrapositive of 'the consolidation amount is worked out only after the ledger carries ...'; the charter's other prerequisite sentence (task 0, 'is fixed only after') runs in the affirmative direction, each chosen for how the desk states that result (a charge-like amount 'is fixed only after'; a move of value 'is not worked out until'); (2) XX is record-visible (a credit_transferred_out entry with reason replacement and its counterpart, read with find_credit_transactions); (3) no tool, id or code token; (4) scope 'the stolen or lost card' named by the request, strength 'not until'. Exactly one write books a replacement transfer-out: the replacement rule ('the transfer-out row on the old instrument names the replacement as counterpart'). Derivation: sentence + ledger (no transfer-out; card locked) + replacement rule -> issue the replacement first. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.credit_instruments.f1871bab.status = locked, close_reason none, and its eight ledger rows are loads, spends and one refund. Flip: the replacement write books the transfer-out of 241.98 to ins_f15d2bdc5fc5 and creates that active card. Deletion sensitivity (run): without the replacement the consolidation amount recomputes to 0.00 instead of 230.00. The persona never mentions a replacement, a hold or a limit; tools validate nothing.  4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Replacement (credit_replaced, credit_transferred_out), governing credit_evt_lost_stolen: replaceable — Marlowe & Finch Gift Card has replaceable_if_lost true; settlement_wait (time) — anchor credit_instruments.locked_date 2026-10-01 (Thursday, day 0), 1 business day (variant), Monday-Friday excluding federal holidays, inclusive: reached Friday 2026-10-02; frozen_time Monday 2026-10-05 satisfies it (just-failing case: 2026-10-01 itself); ownership_proof — registered to his profile 2025-12-04, before the lock, and he is the purchaser of record of line cf3f2729; replacement_limit — no transfer-out with reason replacement in the last 12 months on any of his cards. Overwrite declared: 'loaded with the whole balance at the lock plus refunds received while locked; the old instrument closes with reason replaced' -> loaded with the replacement value (protected balance less the investigation hold); the hold stays frozen on the old card, which closes once nothing is left. Kept: only value at the lock is protected, spending before the lock never reimbursed (the protected balance is the ledger sum, which already reflects every capture), the replacement type and expiry rules. Consolidation (credit_closed_by_customer, credit_transferred_out), governing credit_evt_cash_out (its confirmed-request gate was retired by task 0's overwrite; this policy's own overwrite replaces the consolidation sentence: one named receiving card of the target type instead of a new instrument, the holder's confirmation recording both requests, the amount capped by the move limit, the source closing only when empty) and credit_evt_lost_stolen (policy_scope for the transfer-out subject). Kept: at least consolidation_min_instruments active instruments of a type with consolidation_allowed (the replacement e-gift and the e-gift 3052), receiving card of consolidation_target_variant (e-Gift Card). The 230.00 move keeps the receiving card well under its 500.00 maximum (31.20 + 230.00).  5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target object: stolen card f1871bab (holder C f45947cf). Rows entering the protected balance: its eight credit_transactions rows (load 500.00; spends 72.78, 26.46, 42.17, 34.73, 21.94, 46.75; refund 4.00 received while locked on 2026-10-02 from the price adjustment on order 29c91695). Excluded: the e-gift card's two rows (other instrument). Card-use count: its six spend rows dated within 12 months. The consolidation reads the replacement transfer-out entry on the same card; the tool writes the source (replacement) and receiving (e-gift 1990700b) references on both entries.  6. FACTOR CARD (handling-time runs). Replacement (expected 241.98; whole baseline 259.17 = protected balance with no hold):  - theft_report_hold_share (parameter; both conditions are fields of the card's own record, so not counted as multi-source): reported_stolen, registered 301 days before the lock -> 0.15. Baseline (no share) -> 259.17 (the adjustment alone cannot go below zero). Near-miss: the card is registered, so the 0.40 unregistered share does not apply.  - claim_record_hold_adjustment (parameter, claims cross-difficulty): his only compensation (claim feecabce, 2025-07-21) is 14 months old -> none in the 12-month window -> minus 0.05 -> 0.10. Baseline -> 233.38. Near-miss: a compensated claim exists but outside the window.  - regular_use_release (parameter, multi-source over distinct records): he is the purchaser of record of order line cf3f2729 (order record, his own order 055051fd) AND six orders were paid with the card in 12 months (card ledger, >= 4) -> 30.00 released at once. Near-miss: a card bought by someone else and only registered to him would release nothing at once. Baseline -> 239.73.  - member_hold_treatment (method, loyalty cross-difficulty): Silver enrolled 49 months (>= 12) -> hold 22.92 x0.75 rounded up = 17.19. Baseline -> 236.25. Consolidation (expected 230.00; whole baseline 60.00 = the standard 60.00 limit):  - move_limit_by_standing (parameter, loyalty cross-difficulty; tier and enrolment are one membership record): Silver AND 49 months -> 100.00. Baseline -> 170.00.  - card_age_limit_application (method): card issued 2025-12-01, 10 whole months -> limit x1.5 rounded down to the whole dollar = 150. Baseline (as set) -> 180.00. Near-miss: two more months would lift the limit altogether.  - unlimited_membership_addon (parameter): Unlimited Express Monthly active, covers return labels -> +40.00. Baseline -> 190.00.  - recent_purchasing_addon (parameter, loyalty cross-difficulty): 7 earning postings in 12 months (the July 2025 posting is outside; gift-card purchases earn nothing) -> +30.00. Baseline -> 200.00.  - return_record_limit_change (parameter, returns cross-difficulty): his only return line was authorized 2025-07-25, outside 12 months -> +10.00. Baseline -> 220.00. Near-miss: a return exists, but outside the window. Per-factor sensitivity (gate-recomputed): replacement theft_report_hold_share -> 259.17; claim_record_hold_adjustment -> 233.38; regular_use_release -> 239.73; member_hold_treatment -> 236.25; consolidation move_limit_by_standing -> 170.00; card_age_limit_application -> 180.00; unlimited_membership_addon -> 190.00; recent_purchasing_addon -> 200.00; return_record_limit_change -> 220.00.  7. WHY EACH ROW EXISTS. Customer (identity; WA billing). Loyalty membership + 9 ledger rows (Silver since the 2025-07-10 upgrade; 7 earning postings in the window; points balance = ledger sum). Unlimited Express Monthly (move-limit add-on; explains free Standard Ground shipping from February 2026). 10 orders, 13 order lines, 13 payments (the gift-card purchase proving ownership, the e-gift purchase, the six orders the stolen card paid, the August order the e-gift card helped pay, the July 2025 order behind the claim and the cancelled return, the price adjustment behind the frozen refund and its refund row). 2 instruments + 10 ledger rows (the stolen card and the receiving card). 1 cancelled return + 1 line (return record outside the window). 1 resolved claim + 2 events (claim record outside the window; its card refund is on the payments). Automatic clauses checked: no instrument expires; no depleted card is due to close; no points conversion is owed (1,414 < 2,000); the July 2025 claim and return are closed; nothing in another difficulty is ignited.  8. PERSONA DESIGN. Kenji, calm sound engineer typing between sessions; volunteers the theft, the chat report and the lock (opening facts in initial_state: lock_reason reported_stolen, locked_date 2026-10-01), and the surface goal in his own words; gives email first; phone, ZIP, card endings and how he got the card only when asked; does not know the PIN; passive reactions to 'something must be done with the stolen card first' (go ahead), 'part is held or cannot move today' (accepts), and the hand-over (runs it with the agent's references and amount); ends after the move is confirmed.  9. REACHABILITY WALK. Request -> find_customers(email) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> instruments, ledgers, order lines/orders/payments (ownership), claims, loyalty -> agent explains the replacement must come first; persona agrees -> unlock + replacement (receipt gives the new card reference) -> loyalty ledger, Unlimited, returns, return lines -> agent explains the move limit; persona accepts -> unlock_user + hand-over with the two references and the amount -> the user tool runs -> persona ends. One frozen_time (2026-10-05 10:40:00 EDT); the one-business-day wait already elapsed before the call; no delivery, clearing or review is waited on (the theft review only governs when the frozen hold is later released, which is outside this call and outside gold).  10. CARELESS PATHS. Consolidating the locked card directly (prerequisite missed); replacing for the whole 259.17 (hold missed); reading the claim as recent; counting gift-card purchases as earning postings; treating the 10-month-old card as 12+ months; moving the whole carried value (limit missed); applying the age multiplier after the add-ons (order pinned in the rule).  11. VERIFICATION. _author_t1_eval.py (temporary) replays gold writes and evaluates both computes with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute: replacement 241.98, consolidation 230.00, consolidation without the replacement 0.00; per-task gates --task 1: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK. Revision log: (a) symptom: suite gate needs one task reconciling >= 8 holding ledger rows, this task touched 4; root cause: the protected balance was read off the balance field; change: the replacement rule now defines the protected balance as the sum of every entry on the locked card's ledger (compute SUM over the card's ledger), and the card's year of use was enriched with three more orders (load 500.00); re-run: replacement 241.98, consolidation 230.00, every factor still load-bearing, history rows 9. (b) symptom: tool-contract gate parsed 'of:' as a parameter; change: enum lead-in reworded; re-run: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK.  11b. ROUND-2 REWORK (audit audits/policy_task/gift_cards_and_store_credit, revision 1). F-1 / F-1-T1 symptom: no factor of the replacement or consolidation computations joined conditions over distinct records (every compound ladder read two fields of one row). Root cause: the release-at-once ladder read only the card's ledger. Change: the replacement rule now releases at once only when the holder is the purchaser of record of the order line that bought the card AND the card was used regularly (order record joined with the card ledger, compute binding holder_bought_card via the orders category, declared in cross_category); the multi-source claims for theft_report_hold_share and move_limit_by_standing were withdrawn above. Re-run: replacement and consolidation figures unchanged (he is the purchaser of record), every factor still load-bearing, the task now carries one multi-source factor. Observations closed in the charter: O-3 (refund payable on the day the count reaches the period, stated in words), O-5 (the oldest card-age tier now sets the move limit to the whole carried value, add-ons then apply as stated), O-6 (consolidation docstring no longer points at another action's receipt), O-7 (the edge condition no longer adds 'the replacement card is active'), O-9 (promotional exclusion labelled returns cross-difficulty). Left as observations: O-1 (returns charter settlement-time reconciliation, frozen base, not engaged before settlement), O-2 (inert), O-4, O-8, O-10, O-11, O-T1-1. 12. CLOSURE. replacement -> issue_card_replacement_8a64787f -> replacement_usd at step 11 -> new e-gift card ins_f15d2bdc5fc5, its replacement load, transfer-out on the stolen card (which stays locked holding the hold); consolidation -> confirm_card_consolidation_106a95bf -> consolidation_usd at step 17 -> two confirmed consolidation requests, transfer-out on the replacement, consolidation load on the e-gift card, balances updated. required_documents = charter_scope.extended_policies. Draft recomputation from the visible context alone reaches the same order and figures; the pinned choices (ledger-sum protected balance, hold on the balance above the release, member treatment after the share, card age applied before the add-ons) are stated verbatim in the rules.
user_scenario:
You are Kenji Nakamura, 35, a sound engineer in Seattle who buys most of his clothes from Marlowe & Finch. You are calm and to the point, typing from your phone between sessions. Last Thursday, October 1, your wallet was stolen at a bus stop with your plastic Marlowe & Finch gift card in it; you reported it in the website chat that evening and were told the card was locked. You also have a Marlowe & Finch e-gift card you use for online orders. What you want, in your own words: "I'd like whatever was left on my stolen gift card moved onto my e-gift card so it's all in one place." You want it handled in this call; you are happy for the agent to do whatever needs doing on their side, and you will confirm the move yourself when they hand it to you.
You give your sign-in email, kenji.nakamura@outlook.com, when the agent asks how to find you. Only when asked for more details: your mobile is 2065550152 and your billing ZIP code is 98103. If the agent asks which cards you mean, the stolen plastic card ends in 3417 and your e-gift card ends in 3052. If asked, you bought the plastic card yourself on Marlowe & Finch last November and added it to your account wallet in early December; you do not have it any more and you do not know its PIN by heart. You do not know the balance on either card exactly and you leave that to the agent.
You do not know Marlowe & Finch's procedures and you do not suggest steps. If the agent explains that something has to be done with the stolen card on their side first, you tell them to go ahead. If the agent explains that part of the money is held or cannot be moved today and stays where it is for now, you are not thrilled but you accept it and still want the rest moved. When the agent hands you the confirmation to move the money, you run it yourself with exactly the card references and amount the agent gives you, and read back what it returns if asked. Once the move is confirmed, you thank the agent and end the conversation without bringing up anything else.

base_preconditions.condition: A replacement is issued only for an instrument with `replaceable_if_lost`.
A replacement is issued only once `replacement_wait_business_days` business days have passed since the instrument is locked.

For a card with `replacement_requires_registration_or_proof`, the card must have been registered to the caller's profile before the lock, or the caller must be the purchaser of record of the order line that bought it; a caller who only holds the card number is not enough.
A customer can receive at most `replacement_limit_12m` replacements in a trailing 12 months (credit_msr_replacements_12m); beyond that the case is handed to a human representative.

gold_actions.business_effect: The holder confirms moving the consolidation amount off the replacement card onto his e-gift card; both confirmed requests, the transfer-out and the consolidation load are booked and the rest stays on the replacement.

request_binding.action_semantics: Moving value from one of his cards onto another one he keeps is a consolidation (not a cash-out, which pays money out, and not a second replacement).

temporal_feasibility.condition: A replacement is issued only once `replacement_wait_business_days` business days have passed since the instrument is locked.

temporal_basis.counting_rule: Business days run Monday to Friday excluding US federal holidays, the lock date is day zero, and the replacement may be issued on the day the count is reached.

boundary_check.at_boundary: Friday 2026-10-02 is business day 1 (no federal holiday), the day the count is reached, so a replacement may be issued from then on (inclusive); frozen_time Monday 2026-10-05 is business day 2 and satisfies the wait.

edges.condition: The locked card's credit_transactions hold a credit_transferred_out row with transfer_reason replacement whose counterpart_instrument_id is the replacement card.
edges.policy_source: The consolidation amount is not worked out until the stolen or lost card's ledger carries the replacement transfer-out entry naming the card that took over its protected value.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The stolen card is still locked holding its whole protected balance; its ledger has no transfer-out entry with reason replacement and no replacement card exists, so there is no active card carrying its value that a consolidation could name.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The replacement write books a credit_transferred_out row (reason replacement, counterpart ins_f15d2bdc5fc5) of 241.98 on the stolen card and creates the active replacement ins_f15d2bdc5fc5; carried_value then reads 241.98.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge, no parallel prerequisites. The replacement must come first: the consolidation's source card does not exist before it, and the consolidation policy's prerequisite sentence pins the order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the replacement write leaves no transfer-out entry: carried_value is 0.00 and the consolidation amount recomputes to 0.00 instead of 230.00; the terminal state also lacks the replacement card and its load, and the user call would name a card that does not exist.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario says the card was stolen and locked (a fact of the opening world) and asks for its value to be moved onto the e-gift card; it never mentions a replacement, a hold, a limit or any step to take first. The customer's only reaction to 'something has to be done with the stolen card first' is passive ('tell them to go ahead').
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: confirm_card_consolidation_106a95bf reads both instruments only to copy the holder and update balances, then books the confirmed requests, the transfer-out and the load unconditionally — it never checks that the source is a replacement, that the stolen card was replaced, or any limit; issue_card_replacement_8a64787f likewise issues whatever value it is given without checking the lock reason, the wait, ownership or the hold.
